brief: A child's handwritten supply note: a small sheet torn from a 1960s ruled school exercise book (pale blue lines, one red margin line, a ragged torn left edge), folded once and opened again; on it four lines of large, wobbly grey pencil strokes in a child's hand that look like big capital letters from afar but are only illegible wavy marks, and at the bottom one big wobbly pencil squiggle as a signature. No real letters, no words and no digits.
